# Estimating population structure using interpolation method.

Estimating population structure using interpolation method.

## Usage

``` r
esti_pop(pop1, pop2, period)
```

## Arguments

- pop1:

  Population or population proportion in each age group for the start
  year.

- pop2:

  Population or population proportion in each age group for the end
  year.

- period:

  Vector contain the start year and end year value.

## Value

A data frame contain the estimated population proportion in each year
during the period with each year in one column and each age group in one
row.

## Examples

``` r

pop1 <- c(
  59546, 294129, 472511, 552549, 821119, 996436, 805635, 1004506,
  989357, 1056612, 986559, 792270, 544544, 452297, 473579, 350802,
  212614, 109598, 61990
)
pop2 <- c(
  75641, 377276, 327116, 380338, 539034, 1158852, 1152329, 881443,
  903484, 1011164, 1238871, 1137832, 1022787, 645441, 464777,
  482941, 406144, 227977, 144526
)
esti_pop(pop1, pop2, c(2000, 2010))
```
